_about: Public-domain William Arnot (1808-1875, Free Church of Scotland, Glasgow and Edinburgh) for the Word Hoard: The Parables of Our Lord, clean from Gutenberg; and from the Internet Archive Laws from Heaven for Life on Earth (Proverbs; Nelson, 1873), The Church in the House (Acts; Nisbet, 1875), Roots and Fruits of the Christian Life (1862), The Lesser Parables of Our Lord (1884), The Anchor of the Soul (catalogued 1875) and his Life of James Hamilton (1870). Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 16 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
